notes: A data-driven param is set from the cohort's own metadata, never a static default. Derive it, corroborate it against independent evidence in the SAME record, and STOP to ask when they conflict or the evidence is absent. A wrong value here does not error, it produces a confident wrong result.

seq_type corroboration is on the DNA/RNA axis, which is orthogonal to the TCR-vs-GEX labelling that was wrong in study 241114SHA (both TCR and GEX are RNA). The check is not there to re-catch that bug; it is there for a sample whose SequencingType says RNA but whose filename says WES.

ask.definition: Whether each library is DNA (WES/WGS) or RNA; it changes OptiType's configuration.
ask.on_conflict: The sequencing-type label and the sample's own name/files disagree about DNA vs RNA. I won't guess, which is right?
ask.on_absent: Nothing in these samples' metadata says whether they are DNA or RNA libraries. Which are they?

ask.definition: Whether salmon should skip transcript-length correction. A 3' DGE / tag-counting library (QuantSeq, BRB-seq, MARS-seq) sequences only the 3' end, so a transcript's length says nothing about how many reads it should get, and correcting for it biases every fold change. A standard full-length library needs the correction.
ask.on_conflict: The prep protocol and the kit/library fields disagree about whether this is a 3' tag-counting library or a standard full-length RNA library. Which was prepped?
ask.on_absent: not used — rnaseq assumes a standard full-length library and applies length correction

ask.definition: Single-cell chemistry (10x v2/v3/v4 or Drop-seq/Seq-Well). It changes how the aligner parses cell barcodes and UMIs.
ask.on_conflict: The kit fields, the sample name, and the protocol document disagree about the single-cell chemistry. Which was used?
ask.on_absent: I can't tell which single-cell chemistry was used (the exact version isn't recorded). Which chemistry: 10x v2, 10x v3, 10x v4, or Drop-seq?

ask.definition: The 3' adapter to trim off small-RNA reads. Determined by the library prep kit.
ask.on_conflict: The kit fields and the protocol document disagree about the small-RNA kit / 3' adapter. Which kit was used?
ask.on_absent: not used — smrnaseq falls back to the Illumina adapter
